ADR 0109 S3 sidecar: initial V1 encoder fixture (#1568)

File: group_recovery_v1.bin
SHA-256: 02e7306432af90ff393b108aad7e23392dd6d234f4d3021b92e95fd8c9d5318b
Size: 116334 bytes
Base: 258cd184 (PR #1533, branch claude/issue-1356-s3, ADR 0109 Accepted).
Generated: 2026-10-27, macOS arm64, using this branch's encode_sidecar.
Regenerated: 2026-10-28 (PR #1644 review), before any release, so that no
two same-typed fields hold the same value. postcard is positional: with
equal values, a swap of two same-typed field declarations still decoded
and re-encoded exactly. The encoder and the format did not change.
Command:
  cargo test --lib --all-features groups::recovery::format_fixture -- \
    --ignored --exact groups::recovery::format_fixture::generate_initial_v1_sidecar_fixture

The generator uses a freshly generated, test-only ML-DSA agent key. It sets
every GroupRecoveryV1 field, including attestation_conflict and
authoritative_binding, which ADR 0109 §4 does not list. Each embedded
GroupInfo record has a description that names its field, and the test
checks the expected value of each field. Every signature is
made at 2000000000000 ms; no secret key is stored. The generator uses
create_new and refuses to overwrite this fixture.

This is the INITIAL, UNRELEASED encoder fixture. No released binary writes
X0GRCV1 yet. Keep this file unchanged when the format releases, and add the
release-artifact provenance at that gate, as ADR 0085 rule 6 requires.
Accepted ADR files have not been edited.
